title: Antwort der Bundesregierung auf die Kleine Anfrage: Umsetzung des Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetzes im ersten Quartal 2026 (Drucksache 21/6256)
key_claim: By 13 May 2026 the Bundeswehr personnel office had sent roughly 229,000 registration letters, about half to men; more than 90% of men written to completed the questionnaire; no fines have been issued for non-return; and the government classified the response and screening figures as VS-NfD because publishing them would allow inferences about the Bundeswehr's growth capacity and personnel-requirement planning.
frame_summary: The government is arguing that the new cohort-wide registration and screening machinery is functioning as designed while withholding the numbers that would allow its personnel-supply position to be judged.
verbatim_quote: Mit Stand vom 13. Mai 2026 hat das Bundesamt für Personalmanagement der Bundeswehr rund 229.000 Anschreiben, hiervon rund die Hälfte davon an männliche Personen, versendet.
verbatim_list: Mit Stand vom 13. Mai 2026 hat das Bundesamt für Personalmanagement der Bundeswehr rund 229.000 Anschreiben, hiervon rund die Hälfte davon an männliche Personen, versendet.
Mehr als 90 Prozent der angeschriebenen Männer haben den Fragebogen ausgefüllt.
Es wurde bislang kein Bußgeldbescheid erlassen.
notes: Primary parliamentary document; answer transmitted by the Ministry of Defence letter of 1 June 2026. PDF text extraction contains hard line breaks; quotes are whitespace-normalised only. Framing sentences in the questioners' preamble are not attributed to the government. title: Standortentscheidungen für Musterungszentren getroffen
key_claim: Germany has fixed the locations of 24 dedicated conscription-screening centres across 14 Länder, sited using population-distribution data to target high-density regions with a potentially large applicant volume, each staffed with about 50 civilian posts, to enable nationwide compulsory medical screening from mid-2027; the first centre is expected to open in 2026.
frame_summary: The ministry is arguing that the physical infrastructure for universal cohort screening is now being built, marking a milestone in the new military service and registration system.
verbatim_quote: Für die einzelnen Musterungszentren werden jeweils rund 50 zivile Dienstposten bereitgestellt.
verbatim_list: Für die einzelnen Musterungszentren werden jeweils rund 50 zivile Dienstposten bereitgestellt.
Das erste Musterungszentrum wird voraussichtlich noch in diesem Jahr seine Arbeit aufnehmen.

title: Positive Bewerbungs- und Einstellungslage verfestigt sich im ersten Halbjahr
key_claim: As at end-June 2026 the Bundeswehr recorded roughly 40,500 applications for military careers, up 24% year on year, roughly 10,900 new hires, up 13%, and total military strength of roughly 185,200, up more than 3,600 on June 2025.
frame_summary: The ministry is arguing that the armed forces are becoming steadily more attractive as an employer and that voluntary personnel growth is working, which is the strongest official counter to the claim that compulsion is becoming unavoidable.
verbatim_quote: Mit rund 40.500 Bewerbungen verzeichnen wir ein Plus von 24 % im Vergleich zum Vorjahresmonat (06/2025).
verbatim_list: Mit rund 40.500 Bewerbungen verzeichnen wir ein Plus von 24 % im Vergleich zum Vorjahresmonat (06/2025).
Mit rund 10.900 Neueinstellungen haben wir ein Plus von 13 % im Vergleich zum Vorjahresmonat.
Mit aktuell rund 185.200 Soldatinnen und Soldaten verzeichnen wir im Vergleich zum Juni 2025 einen Zuwachs von mehr als 3.600 Personen.
notes: Counter-evidence from the same ministry that is building the screening capacity, which makes it a strong internal check. title: Nachlässig modernisiert: Zur Genehmigungspflicht nach § 3 Abs. 2 WPflG und der Allgemeinverfügung vom 9. April 2026
key_claim: The Wehrdienst-Modernisierungsgesetz reactivated section 3(2) WPflG, requiring men over 17 to obtain permission from a Bundeswehr career centre before leaving Germany for more than three months; the ministry suspended it by a general order of 9 April 2026, in force 17 April 2026, that exempts all affected men with no application required, but the order is neither time-limited nor conditional.
frame_summary: The author is arguing that the exit-ban outrage was unfounded and the permission requirement is currently suspended, while the real constitutional problems lie in proportionality and in the reach of a ministerial general order.
verbatim_quote: § 3 Abs. 2 Satz 1 WPflG verpflichtet männliche Personen nach Vollendung des 17. Lebensjahres, eine Genehmigung des zuständigen Karrierecenters der Bundeswehr einzuholen, wenn sie die Bundesrepublik für länger als drei Monate verlassen wollen.
verbatim_list: § 3 Abs. 2 Satz 1 WPflG verpflichtet männliche Personen nach Vollendung des 17. Lebensjahres, eine Genehmigung des zuständigen Karrierecenters der Bundeswehr einzuholen, wenn sie die Bundesrepublik für länger als drei Monate verlassen wollen.
Die Genehmigungspflicht galt von 1965 bis zur Aussetzung 2011 und war in dieser Zeit nicht auf den Spannungs- oder Verteidigungsfall beschränkt.
Bemerkenswert ist allerdings, dass die aktuelle Verfügung des BMVg weder befristet noch bedingt ist.
Die Empörung über § 3 Abs. 2 WPflG als vermeintliches Ausreiseverbot war in der Sache unbegründet.

publisher: Kiel Institute for the World Economy
title: German defence budget 2027: a lot of money, the wrong priorities
date_evidence: 08.07.2026 Statement German defence budget 2027: a lot of money, the wrong priorities
key_claim: Kiel Institute defence economist Johannes Binder states that Germany is rich in capital and technology but short on personnel, and that the economically implied response is a highly technology-driven, automated defence strategy, which the 2027 defence budget of nearly 140 billion euro does not deliver.
frame_summary: The author is arguing that Germany's binding constraint is people rather than money, and that the correct response is automation and innovation rather than scaling headcount.
verbatim_quote: Germany is rich in resources such as capital and technology, but short on personnel. From an economic perspective, this points to a highly technology-driven, automated defence strategy.
verbatim_list: Germany is rich in resources such as capital and technology, but short on personnel. From an economic perspective, this points to a highly technology-driven, automated defence strategy.
Despite a record total of nearly €140 billion, an increase of more than €30 billion compared with this year, it still lacks the strategic integration of technology, industrial and defence policy.
notes: Dual-use source: corroborates that personnel rather than money is the scarce factor, and supplies the strongest economic counter-argument, namely that the efficient response is capital and automation substitution rather than a claim on young labour. title: Wanted: European Defence Sector Talent
key_claim: The European defence industry employs roughly 581,000 people on ASD Europe figures, with job postings still more than 40% above pre-war levels, and the median age of Europe's high-tech manufacturing workforce is about 42 to 44, so younger talent pools must be tapped.
frame_summary: The author is arguing that talent rather than money is the decisive constraint on converting European defence spending into capability, and that the industrial base risks becoming the bottleneck.
verbatim_quote: ASD Europe calculates that the European defence industry employs roughly 581,000 people, yet demand for labour has surged sharply since 2022, with job postings remaining over 40% higher than pre-war levels.
verbatim_list: ASD Europe calculates that the European defence industry employs roughly 581,000 people, yet demand for labour has surged sharply since 2022, with job postings remaining over 40% higher than pre-war levels.
notes: Author is an academic specialising in EU defence; commentary reposted from a corporate magazine linked at the foot of the page. The 581,000 and 40% figures are ASD Europe industry-association numbers relayed by the author, so treat directionally. title: Germany's voluntary military service fails to attract new recruits
key_claim: The Bundeswehr planned to send around 650,000 questionnaires in 2026; after more than 300,000 were sent, 530 men and women had committed to service, about 0.7% of the recruitment goal; compulsory medical examination for 18-year-old German men starts July 2027, and the law enables compulsory service to be reintroduced if volunteers remain insufficient.
frame_summary: The article is arguing that Germany's voluntary-first model is failing on its own numbers and that this makes some form of conscription increasingly likely.
verbatim_quote: So far, after more than 300,000 questionnaires have been sent, the total number of new recruits signed up and committed to military service amounts to just 530 men and women, according to recent media reports.
verbatim_list: To this aim, the armed forces planned to send questionnaires to around 650,000 young people this year, or approximately 54,000 per month.

So far, after more than 300,000 questionnaires have been sent, the total number of new recruits signed up and committed to military service amounts to just 530 men and women, according to recent media reports.
That means the Bundeswehr has reached just about 0.7 percent of its recruitment goal so far.
It also mandates 18-year-old German men to undergo a medical examination starting from July 2027.
Crucially, the law enables Germany to bring back compulsory service in the future if there continues to be a lack of volunteers.
notes: Metered paywall; the full body was retrievable on fetch and all quoted passages sit above the membership block. The article's characterisation of the 5,862 objection figure conflates it with the national BAFzA count and is not reused. title: Zahl der Kriegsdienstverweigerer steigt deutlich an: Jetzt schon mehr Anträge als 2025
key_claim: By 30 June 2026 the Federal Office for Family and Civil Society Tasks had received 5,862 conscientious-objection applications, more than in all of 2025 (3,867) and 2024 (2,998), and already above the 2011 suspension-year figure of 4,348; the force is to grow from about 186,000 active soldiers to 260,000 by 2035, failing which a demand-triggered conscription is held in reserve.
frame_summary: The article is arguing that the new military service law and the security situation are driving a record rise in formal opt-outs by young men, even as some earlier objectors reverse course.
verbatim_quote: Bis zum 30. Juni 2026 seien 5862 Anträge beim Bundesamt für Familie und zivilgesellschaftliche Aufgaben eingegangen, sagte eine Sprecherin der Behörde. Im gesamten Jahr 2025 waren es 3867 Anträge, im Jahr 2024 noch 2998.
verbatim_list: Bis zum 30. Juni 2026 seien 5862 Anträge beim Bundesamt für Familie und zivilgesellschaftliche Aufgaben eingegangen, sagte eine Sprecherin der Behörde. Im gesamten Jahr 2025 waren es 3867 Anträge, im Jahr 2024 noch 2998.
Auch der Wert aus dem Jahr 2011, dem Jahr der Aussetzung der Wehrpflicht, wurde mit damals 4348 Anträgen bereits überschritten.

Die Truppe soll von zuletzt 186.000 aktiven Soldatinnen und Soldaten bis 2035 auf 260.000 wachsen. Sollte der Ausbau auf freiwilliger Basis nicht gelingen, behält sich insbesondere die Union die Einführung einer Bedarfswehrpflicht vor.
notes: Numbers sourced to a BAFzA spokesperson via RedaktionsNetzwerk Deutschland. German rendering uses no thousands separator for these figures, copied exactly.
